OpenAI recently updated its redesigned ChatGPT Mac app, making it easier for users to access their conversation history once again. Here are the details.

OpenAI moves to address major complaints after chaotic Mac app overhaul

Last Thursday, OpenAI launched its new ChatGPT Mac app, combining ChatGPT, Codex, and the newly announced Work agent under one roof, while rebranding its older app as ChatGPT Classic.

The change sparked controversy for two main reasons: first, the new app replaced the native Mac client with a bloated Electron-based application; and second, its interface proved baffling, featuring a prominent toggle dropdown for switching between Codex and Work, while the standard Chat experience was demoted to an unobtrusive button that merely opens a floating window with no access to users' existing chat history or Projects.

Following the update, users flooded OpenAI's Community forum and social platform X to voice their displeasure at the chaotic revamp. The very next day, Thibault "Tibo" Sottiaux, who has been leading OpenAI's effort to merge ChatGPT and Codex into a unified "super app," acknowledged the criticism and promised to restore chat history and Projects to the sidebar, clarify the distinction between ChatGPT Work and Codex, and address other usability concerns.

OpenAI has now updated its new ChatGPT app in response to some of these complaints, most notably the inability to access chat history directly. Users can now use a prominent toggle at the top of the window to switch between Chat and Work, and choose between regular ChatGPT or Codex via a dropdown in the sidebar.

9to5Mac's Take

Although the ChatGPT app's interface remains confusing, users who simply open the app to use ChatGPT can finally access the chatbot as before.

However, this inexplicably botched launch—which demoted ChatGPT to a secondary status beneath Work and Codex, combined with the switch to Electron—suggests OpenAI is more focused on competing with Anthropic than delivering a polished experience for users. Fortunately, ChatGPT Classic remains available for as long as it sticks around.
